Audio Priority Bar 2.3.0 adds an in-app update checker. Upgrading from 2.2.0 needs no migration, and your existing priorities and overrides are kept.

## Update checking

- The app checks GitHub for a newer release on launch and once a day while running.
- An available update adds a Download button to the top of the panel, to Settings, and to the right-click menu, plus a one-time system notification.
- Downloading fetches the exact release archive directly, the same file the direct download instructions below use.
- Dismissing the panel's update banner quiets that version for the current run; it returns on the next launch if it's still the latest release.
- **Check for Updates…** in Settings always reports the real state, even for a version already dismissed.
- **Automatically check for updates** in Settings turns the launch and daily checks off.

## Install

```bash
brew install --cask camguillory/tap/audio-priority-bar
```

Alternatively, download `AudioPriorityBar.zip` and `AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256` below into the same folder, verify the archive, and move the app to `/Applications`:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256
```

The release is universal for Apple silicon and Intel. It is ad-hoc signed, not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Jabra Link monitoring may request Input Monitoring permission. Link 380 is hardware-verified. Link 390 is expected to work through the same capability check but remains unverified on hardware, and monitoring fails open when the link state cannot be read.
